fieldValues.title: Rules for adding to the clerk
fieldValues.decision_question: How do we keep the clerk's code solid, reusable and tested now that it is core to the process?
fieldValues.friction: Copies of the same rule already disagree (desk quorumApproved against upkeep wg_verdict), and nothing catches it.
fieldValues.key_requirements: Rules must be checkable by a machine wherever possible, because the reviewers are agents. Existing exceptions must not block the rules: an allowlist that only shrinks.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Adopt the ten clerk rules, each enforced by a check in npm test with a shrinking allowlist for existing exceptions.
fieldValues.rationale: The clerk enforces the programme's rules, so its own rules have to be enforced the same way: by checks, not by memory.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When the allowlist is empty, or when a rule is waived three times in a cycle (it is wrong or too strict).
fieldValues.owner: Owner role (SemanticOps), passing to the group that holds Programme coordination once chartered
